purpose: 供交易员逐对签认；所有标记均为待标注对象，不预置真值

time.encoding: MT5 server wall-clock seconds encoded on Unix numeric scale; not a UTC instant
time.label_rule: format t directly, no additional +3h; label carries historical offset
time.range: core bars start_t inclusive/end_t exclusive; detect_t=causal first observed closed-slot boundary, not extremum time or API completion

algorithms.platform: C2 frozen 3c6d9d7c0; swings2/2 merge3; quality2/3; all types, no current-trend filtering
algorithms.chart_indicators: platform TA-Lib v0.6.4; MACD12/26/9 EMA signal; HIST=DIF-DEA (not doubled); EMA34; rolling251 closed bars per chart bar
algorithms.gdl: formal1.37 same-source C++ Preview; displayed closed-bar candidates only; score at first display; no retrospective Review

selection_protocol.method: OHLC-only; hourly starts, 40 contiguous M15 bars; 09-28..10-23; exclude mandatory Oct14; trend=max efficiency; range=max (1-efficiency)*min(mid_crosses,8)/8; V uses first open+40 closes (not wick): max min(leg efficiencies)*min(drop,rise)/close_range with trough path index15..25 and both legs>=65%close_range; tie earlier; nonoverlap; no marks/model/score/PnL read

notes.quote:
> 依据：交易员对 10/30 01:45–11:45 下跌中三次做空（02:00、08:45、13:05）的讲解及后续确认；回测报告 T20261030-02。

---

## 1. 背景

10/30 下跌（约 56 美元）中，趋势层 108 轮全部确认为空头，引擎却 91 轮"三条路径都不成立"：路径 B 卡在没有回调到 M5 均线或没有 M5 信号，路径 C 卡在没有形成横盘。强势单边行情中，回调不到均线、也不形成横盘，现有三条路径都覆盖不到。交易员的做法是：**H1 与 M15 都是明确空头且都没有背驰时，M5 出现做空信号即进场，趋势不变可以反复进**。
